title: Mbappé launches 'thank you' campaign in open letter to French public after 2026 World Cup

title: Paris luxury boutique sales staff feel the blues: 'Before, we made the customer wait; now, we are the ones waiting for them'
subhead: The number of people shopping at major luxury brands in the French capital has dropped by 11% between January and June. As the sector's traditional base of shoppers from China, Russia and the Gulf dwindles, sales staff are growing worried and bored.

title: Searching for Ingmar Bergman's soul on Sweden's Fårö island
subhead: Captivated by the stark beauty of its landscapes, Bergman lived on the small Baltic island and filmed several of his movies there until his death in 2007. Starting at age 60, he also gathered his nine children – born to six different women – at his home on the island. Today, they continue to honor his memory there.
